findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: listing_match, merchant_agent_profile · Private data: record_purchase_intent, universal_coverage, parts_intelligence · Public sink: merchant_offer_search · Destructive: anime_rarity, record_purchase_intent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: listing_match, merchant_agent_profile · Private data: record_purchase_intent, universal_coverage, parts_intelligence · Public sink: merchant_offer_search · Destructive: anime_rarity, record_purchase_intent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "identify_anime_product" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
